what: HEAD-non-advance branch is not gated on `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` success
scenario_or_breakage: `ship-pr.sh` intentionally omits `set -e`; if `_stage_and_push_ci_fixes` returns non-zero (e.g. `git-push.sh` failure with no commit), the planned HEAD equality check can still run and set `BAIL_REASON=first-fixer-non-health`, misrouting a push/stage failure to Exit 3
suggested_fix: Wrap the new logic in `if _stage_and_push_ci_fixes "$phase" ...; then` and only compare `baseline_head`/`final_head` inside that block; propagate `_stage` failure with `return 1` without setting `first-fixer-non-health`

what: Planned `run_ship_pr_3134_vendor_exit0_no_commits` omits harness preconditions used by sibling vendor cases
scenario_or_breakage: The default `make_repo` state leaves `TRANSIENT_RETRIES=0`, so `run_evaluate_failure` can exit early via `ci-rerun-failed.sh` and never reach `run_ci_fix_vendor`; breadcrumb assertions also require `LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS=1` (see ~2289) or the warn line will not appear on captured stdout
suggested_fix: Mirror sibling fix-loop cases: seed `TRANSIENT_RETRIES=1` and `FAILED_RUN_ID=run3134` in the state file before invoking `ship-pr.sh`, run with `LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS=1`, and stub `run-relevant-checks-captured.sh`/`git-push.sh`/`lint-fix-loop.sh` like `vendor_verify_local_pass` (~3494-3503)

what: New lint quartet is not added to the agent-lint allowlist
scenario_or_breakage: Sibling lints (`lint-bare-grep-probe`, `lint-gh-body-inline`, etc.) are explicitly allowlisted; without entries, `make agent-lint` / relevant-checks can fail on the new `scripts/lint-awk-multibyte-regex*` and `scripts/test-lint-awk-multibyte-regex*` files
suggested_fix: Add the four new paths to `agent-lint.toml` with a short comment matching the `lint-bare-grep-probe` block (~143-146, ~878-881)

what: No pre-commit hook or `docs/linting.md` row for the new lint (unlike `lint-bare-grep-probe`)
scenario_or_breakage: `scripts/relevant-checks.sh` only runs configured pre-commit hooks; authors relying on relevant-checks alone may not see new violations until `make lint`/CI
suggested_fix: [OUT_OF_SCOPE] Optionally add a `lint-awk-multibyte-regex` pre-commit hook and a `docs/linting.md` table row if parity with `lint-bare-grep-probe` is desired; not required for the ship-pr fix path
